slice1Adapter: TypeScript. This specification does not add a Rust adapter and does not mint Rust-as-core. Adapter implementation remains reserved (D-108).
matrix: slice-1 adapter (TypeScript) × four D-002 platforms × {clean, offline, upgrade}
discipline: SPECIFICATION OF EXACT-BYTE INTENT. Occupancy remasurement of the already-named identifier. No harness runs here. No fixture bytes authored.
whatThe51FixturesCover: The 51 authored exact-byte fixtures recorded at D-106 are FG-3 hand-authored evidence that the eight DR-103 admission classes exist (TC-NAME, TC-PATH, TC-ACCEPT, TC-DUP, TC-CLOSURE, TC-BYTE-EXACT, TC-SIG, TC-METADATA-ONLY). They are not fixtureMemberMap keys. They carry no producer standing. FG-3: hand-authoring is lawful evidence that the classes exist; it is not an adapter run. This specification authors no join between corpus ids and map keys.

clean.initialState: Empty install root. Network may be present. No prior admitted tuple.
clean.inactiveOrBlocked: AT-1-TRUSTED-INSTALL remains INACTIVE until DR-112 / ID-DEP-P3. Report blocked-on-ride, not install-success.
clean.passProperty: The TypeScript adapter emits a conformance report whose outputContractMembers cover OC-1..OC-9, whose fixtureClassCoverage includes every AT-* half required by v14 AND every AT-ARCHIVE-* key (seventeen keys; there is no aggregate AT-8 map key), and whose AT-1-ASSEMBLY standing is produced with {path, sha256} for manifest, tree, archive+archiveDigest, and declarations, assembled with no network. Missing signed-closure fields fail. AT-1-TRUSTED-INSTALL is blocked-on-ride. AT-8 / at8.passProperty holds. Members 1 and 2 match schemas.v11. The 51 D-106 fixtures remain FG-3 class evidence, not map-key producers.
clean.exactByteIntent: Per platform: the conformance report bytes, the four assembly artifacts and their sha256, the closedMap standings, and the blocked-on-ride record for AT-1-TRUSTED-INSTALL. Plus the at8.exactByteIntent artifacts. Plus the closedMap standings for all 80 keys on this cell's report.

offline.initialState: After CI-1 pins are present locally, DNS and egress are blocked. No implicit download path.
offline.inactiveOrBlocked: AT-5-TRUSTED-INSTALL remains INACTIVE until DR-112/DR-110. Report blocked-on-ride, not no-network install-success.
offline.passProperty: The adapter run is networkless (CI-2). Any implicit download is RJ-5 plus typed remediation, not a retry. AT-5-ASSEMBLY standing is produced: the emission plus reserved trust slots is complete as bytes for no-network use; missing reserved DR-112/DR-110 material is typed unavailability, not silent success. AT-5-TRUSTED-INSTALL is blocked-on-ride. This is not G06 product air-gap install (HARD-BLOCKED by DR-002–008). AT-ARCHIVE-IDENTITY holds on the offline pins: two networkless runs, identical archive bytes and archiveDigest. All seventeen AT-ARCHIVE-* keys are produced on this cell's report. at8.passProperty holds.
offline.exactByteIntent: The conformance report bytes for this cell. Per platform: the network-denied environment record, the AT-5-ASSEMBLY artifact set and digests, the reserved-slot typed-unavailability records, the RJ-5 record if a download was attempted, and the blocked-on-ride record for AT-5-TRUSTED-INSTALL. Plus the two AT-ARCHIVE-IDENTITY offline-run artifacts and equal archiveDigests. Plus the closedMap standings for all 80 keys on this cell's report.

upgrade.initialState: An already-admitted prior tuple is present on disk. The adapter is asked for a new version from local CI-1 pins.
upgrade.inactiveOrBlocked: AT-6 update/rollback vectors remain INACTIVE until DR-110 and DR-112 close or dispose (ID-DEP-P3). If either closes by scoped disposition, this cell follows that disposition's terms. Until then no adapter may emit updateData semantics.
upgrade.passProperty: The adapter emits a new signed tuple. The prior tuple bytes are bit-identical after the run. AT-6 standing is blocked-on-ride, never install-success and never silent omission. The new tuple obeys the clean-cell AT-1-ASSEMBLY rule. Fail if the prior tuple is mutated, if updateData semantics are emitted, or if the new tuple requires network. AT-ARCHIVE-IDENTITY holds on the new-tuple pins: two runs, identical new-tuple archive bytes and archiveDigest. The prior tuple remains unmutated. All seventeen AT-ARCHIVE-* keys are produced on this cell's report. at8.passProperty holds.
upgrade.exactByteIntent: The conformance report bytes for this cell. Per platform: prior-tuple pre/post digests (must be equal), new-tuple assembly artifacts and digests, the AT-6 blocked-on-ride record naming ID-DEP-P3, and proof that updateData is absent from the emission. Plus the two AT-ARCHIVE-IDENTITY new-tuple run artifacts and equal archiveDigests. Plus the closedMap standings for all 80 keys on this cell's report.

retainedEvidence.measures: The emitted manifest bytes and the tree commitment those bytes bind, against schemas.v11 and the 51-fixture expected bytes where those fixtures apply.
retainedEvidence.exactByteIntent: Per matrix cell and platform: manifest bytes, manifestDigest, treeDigest, archiveDigest, archiveProfileId, the seventeen AT-ARCHIVE-* coverage members plus AT-8 two-run identity artifacts. The fixture pins those artifacts.
retainedEvidence.passProperty: Manifest/tree/archive digests match the pinned expected bytes. A missing signed-closure field required by schemas.v11 fails. No waiver.
retainedEvidence.suppliedBy: The 48 rideless schema-derived keys, AT-1-ASSEMBLY, and AT-8 / all seventeen AT-ARCHIVE-* keys on every cell.

retainedEvidence.measures: Declared provenance, SBOM, license, and notice inventory on the emission (packaging v14 OC-3; schemas.v11 TC-ACCEPT declarations).
retainedEvidence.exactByteIntent: Per matrix cell and platform: declarations.provenance, declarations.sbom, declarations.licenses (or approved-exception typed absence), each with {path, sha256}.
retainedEvidence.passProperty: Every required declaration is present or carries a typed approved-exception absence. Location-inferred trust fails.
retainedEvidence.suppliedBy: Rideless TC-ACCEPT/TC-DUP keys on every cell; OC-3 on every cell.

retainedEvidence.measures: Two halves. Compatibility: emitted compatibility data only; window evaluation is DR-111 (packaging ID-DEP-P2 / schemas ID-DEP-4). Health: AT-4 closed applicability record; actual negotiation remains DR-102 / DR-G21.
retainedEvidence.exactByteIntent: Per matrix cell and platform: the compatibility object as emitted (unevaluated), plus conformanceReport.healthAndSubprotocol {roleSubprotocol, subprotocolVersion, applicability[]} with exactly one unique {role, platform} member equal to subject.role + subject.platform. executed-pass and executed-fail require {path, sha256}. not-applicable and blocked-on-ride require ride AT-4 / ID-DEP-P4.
retainedEvidence.passProperty: Compatibility windows are not evaluated. Health standing is present; empty, missing, extra, duplicate, or unrelated applicability fails. Omission of health without a ride fails. Frames are not translated.
retainedEvidence.suppliedBy: AT-4 and OC-4. Not supplied by the 51 fixtures.

retainedEvidence.measures: AT-5-ASSEMBLY: emission plus reserved trust slots complete as bytes for no-network use. AT-5-TRUSTED-INSTALL stays INACTIVE. This is not G06 authoritative product air-gap.
retainedEvidence.exactByteIntent: The offline-cell artifacts named under matrixCells.offline.exactByteIntent.
retainedEvidence.passProperty: The offline cell's passProperty. Clean and upgrade cells retain the same assembly completeness; they do not claim trusted no-network install-success.
retainedEvidence.suppliedBy: AT-5. Not supplied by the 51 fixtures.

retainedEvidence.measures: AT-6. DECLARED as a class. Vectors INACTIVE until DR-110 and DR-112 close or dispose. Slice-1 upgrade is a new emission beside an unmutated prior tuple.
retainedEvidence.exactByteIntent: The upgrade-cell artifacts named under matrixCells.upgrade.exactByteIntent.
retainedEvidence.passProperty: The upgrade cell's passProperty. Clean, offline, and upgrade reports require AT-6 blocked-on-ride with the recorded ride ID-DEP-P3/DR-110/DR-112. not-applicable is excluded. Never a performed rollback.
retainedEvidence.suppliedBy: AT-6 standing plus the upgrade-cell new-tuple rule. Not supplied by the 51 fixtures.

retainedEvidence.measures: AT-7. The emission binds {path, sha256} joins for each applicable owner-defined gate among DR-G01..G05 / DR-115 / DR-118 / DR-G13. Threshold VALUES remain those owners. This class does not invent numbers.
retainedEvidence.exactByteIntent: Per matrix cell and platform: gateResults[] of {gate, standing: pass|fail|blocked-on-ride, evidence {path, sha256} when pass or fail}.
retainedEvidence.passProperty: Every applicable gate has a standing. pass requires the owner-defined result to be present, custody-verified, and passing. If the owner has not supplied a gate or disposition, standing is blocked-on-ride, never compliant. A digest-bound failing result is fail. G01-G05 size comparison waits on the D-006 unit successor; exclusion-membership results may pass now. G13 remains reserved and is blocked-on-ride. DR-118 thresholds are not invented here.
retainedEvidence.suppliedBy: AT-7. Not supplied by the 51 fixtures.

retainedEvidence.measures: hermeticCI CI-1..CI-5 and localDeveloperValidation LV-1..LV-4. Same rules locally and in CI.
retainedEvidence.exactByteIntent: Per matrix cell and platform: CI-1 pins (source tree, tool closure, adapter version, platform target, exception-approval records), adapterVersionDigest, the reproducible tuple (manifests, trees, archiveDigest, declaration digests, report members except runId), and LV-2 diagnostics when a field fails.
retainedEvidence.passProperty: Every input is named and digest-pinned. The adapter run is networkless. Identical resolution-class inputs yield identical tuples except runId. A missed input, unpinned tool, or dirty worktree is typed non-success. archiveProfileId equals opensip-archive-profile.1. Local validation does not admit, sign, or publish. Byte-identical manifests/index remain conditional on ID-DEP-1.
retainedEvidence.suppliedBy: CI-1..CI-5 and LV-1..LV-4. Not supplied by the 51 fixtures.

at8.name: archive profile byte identity and negatives
at8.standing: ACTIVE. None of the seventeen AT-ARCHIVE-* keys carries a ride. Lawful standing is produced with {path, sha256}. Silence, class-wide stand-in, not-applicable, and blocked-on-ride are report-invalid.
at8.identityCase: AT-ARCHIVE-IDENTITY is two adapter RUNS with identical CI-1/CI-5 pins emitting identical archive bytes and archiveDigest. Slice-1 TypeScript is sufficient. This is not a second-language adapter and does not mint Rust-as-core.
at8.exactByteIntent: Per matrix cell and platform (twelve reports): fixtureClassCoverage members for all seventeen AT-ARCHIVE-* keys, each standing produced with {path, sha256}; the two AT-ARCHIVE-IDENTITY run artifacts and their archiveDigest (must be equal); the AT-ARCHIVE-FIXED-VECTOR digest-pinned expected archive; ACCEPT artifacts for NAME-100, LINK-100, MODE-2097151, SIZE-8589934591; refusal records for BODY-MISMATCH, TARGET-MISMATCH, EXTRA-MEMBER, MISSING-MEMBER, NAME-101 (PATH-EXCEEDS-USTAR-NAME), LINK-101 (LINKTARGET-EXCEEDS-USTAR-LINKNAME), TYPEFLAG-NUL, CHKSUM-SPACES, NONCANON-UID, MODE-2097152 (MODE-EXCEEDS-USTAR-FIELD), SIZE-8589934592 (SIZE-EXCEEDS-USTAR-FIELD).
at8.passProperty: Every AT-ARCHIVE-* key is present with standing produced and evidence on every one of the twelve reports. The two identity runs of that cell are byte-identical in archive bytes and archiveDigest. Each refusal key yields the v14 expected typed non-success. Each ACCEPT key yields ACCEPT. Missing keys fail. A report that omits the seventeen keys is invalid under this specification and under v14.

reportUnit.rule: One conformance report per matrix cell per D-002 platform. Matrix is one TypeScript adapter × four platforms × {clean, offline, upgrade} = twelve reports.
reportUnit.not: Not one report per platform. Not one report for the whole matrix. Not an emission-without-report on offline or upgrade.
reportUnit.eachReport: Every report uses the v14 conformanceReport shape and carries all 80 fixtureMemberMap keys. The 48 rideless schema-derived keys, the 17 AT-ARCHIVE-* keys, and the 5 rideless AT halves (AT-1-ASSEMBLY, AT-2, AT-3, AT-4, AT-5-ASSEMBLY) stand produced with {path, sha256}. The 5 rided schema-derived keys and the 4 rided AT halves (AT-1-TRUSTED-INSTALL, AT-4-NEGOTIATION, AT-5-TRUSTED-INSTALL, AT-6) stand blocked-on-ride with their recorded ride; they are not produced. AT-7 stands pass-or-blocked-on-ride under ID-DEP-P7 as closedMap.at7 states. The produced modifier does not apply to any rided key. Missing keys fail.

closedMap.rule: Every one of the twelve reports carries all 80 keys. Missing keys are report-invalid. Class-wide stand-ins are report-invalid. A rideless key may not be not-applicable or blocked-on-ride.

producedRidelessSchemaDerived.standing: produced with {path, sha256} on every report
